reviews.author: R. Hardwick
reviews.text: Thank you Lance and Junior!! Very happy with tires on both the Beemer and the truck!! Great alignment job on truck also. Rides like a new one again. Great price,great service!! Hard to find these days. Will be back!!

reviews.author: Wright Anderson
reviews.text: Meant to do this a while back. The guys at freeman are awesome. They will 100% have my business going forward on any vehicle I own. If I could give more than 5 stars I would! Thank you Lance and team!

reviews.author: Zachary Hancock
reviews.text: Freeman’s is the best place for all of your automotive mechanical needs. Lance and his family are good people, and they always do an excellent job. Their prices are fair, and they are usually timely. They’ve always gone above and beyond for me, and they will continue to have my business. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.author: LilMean N-Lean
reviews.text: Best people and prices ever! You wont find better anywhere in the USA trust me I've been alot of places. You can trust them. GOOD PEOPLE!

reviews.author: Dale Gilreath
reviews.text: Freeman Tire always comes through with friendly, reliable service done in a timely manner. With a 20 year old car, things are starting to need repair/replacement. I've had nothing but satisfaction with the mechanic work. I also recently got a full set of tires from them. Prices are extremely competitive. I dont go anywhere else!

reviews.author: Robert Woolfenden
reviews.text: Every time I've taken my vehicles to Freeman's Tire Service whether it be for an oil change, tire replacement/repair or major maintenance the results are always the same, the tasks are professionally and expertly accomplished. I highly recommend Freeman's Tire Service for your automotive needs.

reviews.author: Jkb Xpress
reviews.text: The one to ask for if you go here is Travis Tilton, he knows what's going on, he's quick to know what needs to be done in the most economical way. He's an excellent mechanic, I wouldn't let anyone else in town work on my vehicles, except Travis. Freeman was 120 less on same problem presented to gnr, they are eye gouging, and unorganized.

reviews.author: April Tedder
reviews.text: Had to get 4 new tires put on my van. Lance Freeman is who worked hard to make sure I had good tires. I appreciate Mrs. Pam, & Junior

reviews.author: Smile
reviews.text: Scratched my rims with the machine same pattern on all rims. Admitted another customer complaining of same thing but yet it isn't her son doing it to them. She hung up on me an when I call back he answers an says she doesn't want to speak to me. Not to mention stripped two lug nuts an said it wasn't there responsibility.
